messages:
sara: Heads-up — customer ticket #12345. Tool call returns 400 with a parser error. They pasted the raw body and it looks like UTF-16LE with BOM. Error: "invalid character '\\x00' looking for beginning of value"

sara: customer says request headers: `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16` and they're sending the JSON directly (not base64). Here's the truncated raw payload they provided (showing null bytes when decoded as UTF-8):

```
ff fe 7b 00 22 00 74 00 6f 00 6f 00 6c 00 22 00 3a 00 20 00 7b 00 22 00 6e 00 61 00 6d 00 65 00 22 00 3a 00 20 00 22 00 77 00 69 00 6e 00 5c 00 70 00 61 00 74 00 68 00 22 00 2c 00 20 00 22 00 66 00 61 00 67 00 22 00 3a 00 20 00 22 00 5c 00 75 00 30 00 30 00 41 00 22 00 7d 00 7d 00
```

sara: When our ingress decodes this as UTF-8 you get interleaved NULs (\x00) which trips Go's json.Unmarshal and we return a 400.

mike: Can you repro locally with curl? If they really send UTF-16LE we should either 1) return 415 unsupported charset, or 2) detect BOM and transcode to UTF-8 before JSON parse.

sara: Repro curl they used (from customer):

```
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16" --data-binary @payload_utf16le.bin https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall
```

sara: payload_utf16le.bin contains the UTF-16LE bytes (with ff fe BOM) — not escaped.

nora: We currently assert UTF-8 in the ingress fast-path. Historically we didn't expect clients to change charset. I think returning 415 is safer than trying to guess. But we could implement a small BOM sniff to accept UTF-16LE/BE and transcode.

mike: Quick note: the error message on our side is unhelpful: "invalid character '\\x00'..." — we should catch encoding issues earlier and return something like "unsupported charset; only UTF-8 is supported". Also add a log line capturing Content-Type header.

sara: Customer asked for a workaround they can do today. I told them to re-encode the JSON as UTF-8 or to base64 the payload and use our binary upload endpoint. They prefer a change on our side but may accept doc fix.

nora: Can we also add a validation step that rejects content with embedded NULs before handing to json.Unmarshal? It would let us give a clearer 400 vs the opaque parser error.

mike: I'll file an internal ticket: INF-2981. Plan: (A) add explicit charset check and return 415 if not utf-8; (B) add optional BOM detection/transcoding behind a flag; (C) improve error wording and logs.

sara: Thanks — I'll tell customer the short-term plan and ETA.

ops-bot: deployment scheduled: services/ingress  -> canary at 2024-05-23T18:00Z (note: change will be feature-flagged) :rocket:
__notes: This thread captures a support->engineering escalation about tool call failures caused by clients sending UTF-16LE JSON (BOM + interleaved NULs). The messages are short and include a raw byte dump, curl repro, suggested fixes, and an internal action (INF-2981).
